interpretation_boundary: This is a deterministic candidate draw only. It executes no wet-lab or hardware work and adds no physical claim.

hard_stop.action: Do not admit the specimen as a useful conductive bridge.
hard_stop.condition: Post-bridge conductance is below the floor.

provenance.text: Conservative admission floor below the published order-of-magnitude bridge conductance.

hard_stop.action: Reject optical steering at this dose and geometry.
hard_stop.condition: Paired median bridge-time change is below the threshold and displacement criterion also fails.

provenance.text: Predeclared bridge-time effect floor for the paired falsifier.

hard_stop.action: Report conductance only and withhold conductivity-based admission.
hard_stop.condition: Geometry-supported effective conductivity is below the floor or geometry was not measured.

provenance.text: Admission floor below the companion study's image-derived conductivity range; valid only when geometry is reconstructed.

hard_stop.action: Reject optical steering at this dose and geometry.
hard_stop.condition: Paired median directed displacement is below the threshold and bridge-time criterion also fails.

provenance.text: Spatial effect floor chosen to exceed a fine branch-scale registration ambiguity.

hard_stop.action: Do not evaluate the optical steering gate.
hard_stop.condition: Fewer paired chips complete without protocol violations.

provenance.text: Smallest paired screen chosen to require repeatable direction rather than a single photomicrograph.

hard_stop.action: Reject optical steering at this dose and geometry.
hard_stop.condition: Directional success count is below the threshold.

provenance.text: Predeclared sign-consistency requirement for the smallest optical falsifier.

hard_stop.action: Do not energize the cell; reject the batch or restore the safety controls.
hard_stop.condition: Prepared concentration is outside the allowable range or lot SDS controls are unavailable.

provenance.text: Published exact-stack BQ concentration.

hard_stop.action: Reject the batch and prepare a fresh electrolyte.
hard_stop.condition: Prepared concentration is outside the allowable range.

provenance.text: Published exact-stack aqueous EDOT concentration.

hard_stop.action: Invalidate the specimen's mass-budget comparison.
hard_stop.condition: Calculated reservoir falls outside the range after measured volume and concentration are entered.

provenance.text: Derived from the proposed droplet volume and established EDOT concentration; used as the finite material budget.

hard_stop.action: Reject the mass accounting and inspect calibration or contamination.
hard_stop.condition: Reported deposited mass exceeds the measured starting reservoir mass.

provenance.text: Stoichiometric upper bound from EDOT amount and molar mass before yield and counter-reaction losses.

hard_stop.action: Discard the droplet and prepare a fresh cell; do not normalize an evaporation error after growth.
hard_stop.condition: Measured volume is outside the allowable range.

provenance.text: Published exact-stack droplet volume; range is the proposed handling tolerance.

hard_stop.action: Reject the batch and prepare a fresh electrolyte.
hard_stop.condition: Prepared concentration is outside the allowable range.

provenance.text: Published exact-stack NaPSS concentration.

hard_stop.action: Stop and classify the specimen outside the Earth manifest.
hard_stop.condition: Pressure leaves the ambient range or the cell is placed under vacuum.

provenance.text: Ambient-pressure Earth regime; explicitly excludes vacuum inference.

hard_stop.action: Pause growth and reject the matched comparison if the paired lane did not share the excursion.
hard_stop.condition: Cell temperature exits the range.

provenance.text: Controlled ambient starting point for matched wet-cell comparisons.

hard_stop.action: Reject the cell before energizing.
hard_stop.condition: Exposed length is outside range or passivation enters the tip gap.

provenance.text: Leaves a visible growth zone while Parylene-C shields the inactive lead length.

hard_stop.action: Reposition or replace the wires before adding electrolyte.
hard_stop.condition: Measured pre-growth tip gap is outside the allowable range.

provenance.text: Reproduces the published nominal geometry with a bounded placement tolerance.
Published exact-stack Au wire diameter.

hard_stop.action: Trip the source output and preserve the last synchronized frame.
hard_stop.condition: Measured current reaches the compliance ceiling.

provenance.text: Conservative first-cell ceiling chosen to prevent an uncontrolled post-bridge current surge while retaining the published millisiemens-scale envelope.

hard_stop.action: Stop and correct the waveform before continuing.
hard_stop.condition: Measured duty fraction is outside the allowable range.

provenance.text: Published bridge-growth duty fraction.

hard_stop.action: Stop the waveform immediately and reject the run as electrolysis-confounded.
hard_stop.condition: Frequency is below the minimum or visible bubbling begins.

provenance.text: Published bridge-growth frequency; the cited setup bubbled below ten hertz.

hard_stop.action: Stop the growth waveform; classify as timeout or bridge completion.
hard_stop.condition: No bridge is detected by the timeout or a bridge is detected earlier.

provenance.text: Bounds energy and chemical exposure around the faster published bridge condition.

hard_stop.action: Open the output relay and mark the specimen electrically overstressed.
hard_stop.condition: Commanded or measured peak-to-peak voltage exceeds the maximum.

provenance.text: Published companion study used a ten-volt peak-to-peak bipolar signal; adopted as the upper first-cell setting.

hard_stop.action: Recalibrate projection before dosing the specimen.
hard_stop.condition: Calibrated projected width is outside range.

provenance.text: Resolvable corridor narrower than the electrode gap and wider than a single fine branch.

hard_stop.action: Blank the projector and reject the exposure as over-dose or thermally confounded.
hard_stop.condition: Measured irradiance exceeds the maximum or local temperature exits its range.

provenance.text: Upper first-screen irradiance selected for a paired optical-leverage test, not asserted as a published dendrite-growth value.

hard_stop.action: Do not combine the run with the calibrated optical cohort.
hard_stop.condition: Measured peak wavelength is outside range.

provenance.text: Visible DMD-compatible starting wavelength; direct optical steering of this Au-wire chemistry remains the tested unknown.

hard_stop.action: Trip the read and inspect for a hard short.
hard_stop.condition: Read current reaches compliance.

provenance.text: Bounds read power above the admission conductance while remaining below the growth-current ceiling.

hard_stop.action: Abort the read and mark it non-comparable.
hard_stop.condition: Read duration exceeds the upper bound.

provenance.text: Short read interval limits charge injection while allowing synchronized conductance sampling.

hard_stop.action: Abort the read to avoid confusing continued electrochemistry with passive conductance.
hard_stop.condition: Read command exceeds the maximum.

provenance.text: Low-voltage PEDOT dendrite readout demonstrated in the companion electrical study.
